title: Quantum Depth Compression via Local Dynamic Circuits
summary: We present Quantum Depth Compression (QDC), a general compilation framework that utilizes dynamic circuits to reduce arbitrary quantum circuits to depth linear in the number of non-Clifford gates and to grid connectivity without the need for expensive SWAP-networks. The framework consists of pushing Clifford gates to the end of the circuit, resulting in a sequence of non-Clifford Pauli-phasors followed by an all Clifford sub-circuit, both of which are then reduced to constant depth via dynamic circuits.
